test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dbabe43087424d5e64693d98ee6d4ec1e985ee3a628c8cd52539f747186f823.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Double line side is rotated 45º clockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f32b20ae36bd2c030e8f4bf1771ed92db4edf37b42cf4e78b501a806d91b128.png] 

2) In every next figure one extra line is added.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d0096a3aef7ce2350b50abeda06adcf463ec739d12e88a0aac40c4606ca61d3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
